title: FanOps CI Control Registry
description: Validation schema for .github/ci-control-registry.yml, enforced by tools/ci/registry.py on every `tools.ci static` and every run of tests/test_ci_registry_validator.py in the required unit lane. A validation failure names the exact path and constraint.

status.description: Lifecycle of the registry document itself.

required_contexts.description: The required branch-protection contexts. DC-3 requires LIVE GitHub protection to equal this exactly — change both in the same PR. DC-1 requires each entry to match a real workflow job name, and each must be the branch_protection_context of a control classified 'required'.

control.description: One row per workflow job. DC-2 enforces the bijection in both directions, so this list is exhaustive by construction: adding a job without a row reddens the required unit lane.

id.description: STABLE identity — never a mutable job display name. Renaming a job MUST NOT change this id.

classification.description: required = in live branch protection, and blocks; advisory = runs on PR, reports, does not block (DC-7 additionally requires `continue-on-error: true` on the job); scheduled = cron/dispatch only.

workflow.description: Path to the implementing workflow file.

job.description: Workflow job id — the YAML key under `jobs:`, stable within the file. NOT the display name.

branch_protection_context.description: The exact check-run context string, i.e. the job's `name:`. MUST be present when classification == 'required' — that is the anti-silent-detach mechanism DC-1 reads. Optional otherwise, and worth setting on an advisory job so DC-4 can catch prose that miscalls it.

allOf.$comment: A required control MUST declare its branch-protection context. DC-1 compares that string against real workflow job names, so an unmirrored rename is caught instead of silently detaching the gate.
